summary.en-US: Filter X For You by your follows, hide detected ads, and count blocked posts.

description.en-US: Local following-network filtering, optional promoted-post hiding, and session counts. Automatic following sync requires X OAuth/API setup and authorization; API reads may incur charges. No scrolling after setup. Manual lists remain available. No developer backend or telemetry. See PRIVACY.md and docs/AUTO-SYNC.md in the source.

version.approval_notes: Readable source; build with Python 3.10+: python build.py. Firefox output: dist/firefox. Automatic sync requires an X OAuth public client and API access, not bundled. Publisher must provide reviewer instructions/access privately. See docs/REVIEWER-NOTES.md and PRIVACY.md. Local tests do not validate live X or API authorization.
